set.body:
Why
NumPy is strongest inside one mature dtype loop and weaker when ordinary code builds chains of temporary arrays. Ravel can close the useful-work gap by expressing a bounded typed chain once and executing it in one traversal, while preserving eager APIs for simple calls.

Scope
- Design a small typed element-program IR for supported unary, binary, scalar, comparison, selection, and cast operations. Dtype, Boolean result, broadcasting, and output ownership remain explicit.
- Compile or specialize the program before traversal so the hot loop contains direct operations. Per-element AST interpretation, virtual dispatch, closure calls, boxing, or dynamic tag switching are rejection conditions.
- Fuse compatible chains into one output pass and stream masks directly into selection or reduction consumers when no public intermediate is requested.
- Provide allocating and Into execution, deterministic overlap handling, and a conservative fallback for unsupported programs or layouts.
- Compare against idiomatic NumPy with out= and temporary reuse where available, not deliberately naive NumPy expressions.

Scala.js impact
This is likely the highest-leverage shared optimization for JavaScript: fewer typed-array allocations and memory passes give V8 a single monomorphic loop to optimize. The proof must inspect full-linked JavaScript enough to rule out per-element interpreter and closure machinery, and must test Node separately because JVM code shape is not predictive of V8. Scala.js Long remains correctness-only.

Acceptance
- Representative two-, three-, and five-stage programs cover arithmetic, predicate or comparison, cast, broadcast, selection, strided input, and reusable output.
- Materialized results exactly match the unfused eager composition on JVM and Scala.js, including NaN, infinity, signed zero, integer overflow, empty axes, and alias behavior.
- Targeted multi-stage public workloads improve at least 1.50x and eliminate intermediate-size allocation on JVM and full-linked Node; weaker designs are revised or rejected.
- Simple one-operation calls do not regress more than 10 percent.
- Laws, semantic signatures, source compatibility, fullLink, and browser correctness pass.
set.title: Implement typed fused element programs and streaming masks
